items.q: What is an NFC Google review stand?
items.a: It's an item with an NFC chip and a QR code: customers hold their phone close and your Google review page opens, with no app and no searching in Maps. At ONDE it's a 12 × 12 cm clear acrylic stand with a white or black print, with no subscription. The same technology comes as a card, a keychain and a sticker.

items.q: Does it work with every phone?
items.a: Yes. NFC tapping works on iPhone XR, XS and newer, and on the vast majority of NFC-enabled Android phones. For the rest, the QR code on our stands opens exactly the same link. No app to install.

items.q: How do I find my Google review page link?
items.a: From your Google Business Profile: “Read reviews”, then “Get more reviews”, then “Copy”. No profile yet, or can't find the link? We find it with you during the confirmation call.

items.q: Can I change the link later?
items.a: Yes, anytime. The chip holds a permanent ONDE link: we switch its destination remotely (Google reviews, Instagram, menu, website…). No need to buy or reprint anything, just message us on WhatsApp.

items.q: How do I get more Google reviews?
items.a: Offer it to every customer at the end of their visit, and make it instant: one tap at the counter instead of a search in Maps. Reply to reviews too, and never offer anything in exchange for a review: Google forbids it.
Delivery within 3 days of confirmation, anywhere in Tunisia: we call you to confirm your order, configure your product, then deliver it. Delivery costs {fee} and is free from {threshold}.
In cash, on delivery. No bank card needed. And after your first delivered order, the next one is {pct}% off.

Yes: when you order, tell us your business name and the link you want, for example your Google review page. We configure the chip and the link before shipping. For anything special, message us on WhatsApp.
A very long time. The NFC chip is passive: no battery, nothing to charge, nothing to update. Our stands are made of rigid 3 mm acrylic, built for life on a counter.
